inputs.text: Daniel Rubenstein’s talk of “success” and political resolution seems like cover for keeping the operation going and maintaining pressure on Iran. Israel’s refusal to compromise on Iran’s nuclear and missile programs makes its language of peace sound more like narrative management than a genuine change of course. They want the public to accept both stories at once, keeping scrutiny away from who benefits from the operation continuing.
